{"summary":"当前草稿为第十一章《未归的航标》，已写内容显示林默在雾港核对潮汐表。已确认记忆中，航图位于雾线水门外锚柱，黄铜罗盘由温岚持有，低室电台在第6章21:05收到三次求救码，异常雾钟与白色渡船仍为未解线索。","summary_sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-25bff7e4-8311-49b7-83ff-e35d55b6b4f8-r2-1"},{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-3e33a17c-cf1a-46ec-8c43-c434928bd39f"},{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-b6a3c6d3-2d0a-430a-86d6-71b1d8ea0d68"}],"items":[{"section":"recent_source","text":"当前草稿第十一章《未归的航标》已写内容为：林默在雾港核对潮汐表。","sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-25bff7e4-8311-49b7-83ff-e35d55b6b4f8-r2-1"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认：航图位于雾线水门外锚柱。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-3e33a17c-cf1a-46ec-8c43-c434928bd39f"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认：黄铜罗盘由温岚持有。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-b6a3c6d3-2d0a-430a-86d6-71b1d8ea0d68"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认：低室电台在第6章21:05收到三次求救码。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-ca32f291-3015-498f-834a-5eb097ec2908"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认：西航道退潮时间为第3章19:20。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-918f3d79-776c-4ec7-acc9-8f8f512be894"}]},{"section":"world_rule","text":"已确认规则：灰港雾钟只在北潮闸完全关闭后敲响一次。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-41790fbb-5bb3-454a-bd38-fe633b26bae4"}]},{"section":"open_thread","text":"未解线索：异常雾钟在北潮闸未关闭时响起，原因未解。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-cfb987d8-9bf8-488a-a210-1073d9db5048"}]},{"section":"open_thread","text":"未解线索：白色渡船没有靠岸，来源未明。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-3c35a467-72aa-4680-a224-359dcadc9954"}]},{"section":"character_state","text":"温岚不知道廊桥钥匙的含义。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-eaf25836-9bff-4567-8817-b1ee36b3b1ec"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第7章《潮线之外》中，航图被固定在雾线水门外的锚柱上，右下角缺失了一块。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-21258d7d-d874-474d-85e8-001d3010e852"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第6章《低室电台》中，电台在二十一点零五分收到三次短促求救码，信号来自雾线水门以外。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-33cc02cf-af60-4d82-aa03-034c3146dc2c"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第10章《回声坐标》中，北潮闸并未关闭，雾钟却响了一次；温岚仍握着罗盘，港外传来白色渡船的汽笛。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-e754f1a3-1d84-4240-a9de-c5fac568eb39"}]}]}
